slides.headline: One of 7 impossible math problems. AI says it's solved.
OpenAI claims major math win
slides.body: The company says its new model solved a Millennium Problem — one of seven puzzles with a $1 million prize each.

slides.headline: Why these problems matter
slides.body: They underpin modern encryption. A solution could break the codes protecting your bank login, messages, and medical records.

slides.headline: No proof shared yet
slides.body: OpenAI has not published the solution for mathematicians to check. Until peers verify it, the claim remains unproven.

slides.headline: What happens if it's true
slides.body: Banks, governments, and apps would need new security fast. The transition could take years and cost billions.
